en.headline: Police seize HK$450,000 of drugs in Tsuen Wan industrial flat
en.dek: A 23-year-old mainland man was arrested after officers found ketamine, cocaine and etomidate vape pods in a Sha Tsui Road unit used as a stash, police said.
body: Tsuen Wan district special duties officers arrested a 23-year-old mainland man on suspicion of trafficking in dangerous drugs after a raid on an industrial building in Sha Tsui Road on Thursday evening, police said.

Officers began the operation at about 6pm on 17 September. They stopped a man they described as acting suspiciously inside the building, then searched the unit where he was living. Police said they seized about 745 grams of suspected ketamine, about 202 grams of suspected cocaine, 132 suspected etomidate vape pods and packaging tools including an electronic scale and resealable plastic bags. The haul was valued at about HK$450,000.

Police said they believe the flat was used to store and repack drugs. The source of the drugs, any sales network and whether other people were involved remain under investigation. The man was being detained. Officers said they would not rule out further arrests.

Etomidate, a medical anaesthetic, has in recent years been added to e-cigarette liquid and sold as what police call space-oil drugs. Under the Dangerous Drugs Ordinance, trafficking in a dangerous drug carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment.

zh.headline: 荃灣工廈搜出45萬元毒品 23歲內地男涉販毒被捕
zh.dek: 荃灣警區特別職務隊週四晚上在沙咀道工廈單位檢獲氯胺酮、可卡因及依托咪酯煙彈，拘捕一名23歲內地男子。
body: 警方表示，荃灣警區特別職務隊週四晚上約6時在沙咀道一幢工業大廈採取反毒品行動，拘捕一名23歲內地男子，涉嫌販運危險藥物。
警員在大廈內截查一名形跡可疑男子，其後搜查他在上址居住的單位，檢獲約745克懸疑氯胺酮、約202克懸疑可卡因、132粒懸疑依托咪酯煙彈，以及電子磅、透明可再封膠袋等懸疑包裝工具。檢獲毒品總市值約5萬港元。
警方初步相信單位用作儲存及分拆包裝毒品，來源、銷售渠道及是否涉及其他人仍在調查。該男子現正被扣留，警方不排除稍後有更多人被捕。
依托咪酯原為醫療麻醉藥物，近年被加入電子煙煙油，俗稱太空油毒品。根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物最高可判罰款500萬元及終身監禁。
